content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Stripe and PayPal offer comprehensive payment solutions, but their reach is limited to select countries. Stripe provides a robust API for developers and a seamless payment experience for customers, but its availability is confined to a fraction of the global market. PayPal, while more widely recognized, also imposes geographical restrictions that affect creators in many regions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack enables creators to build their own payment systems without relying on external platforms. This approach allows for complete ownership and control over the sales process.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal both exclude numerous countries, effectively sidelining many creators. For instance, creators in Nigeria or Ghana may find themselves unable to process payments through these platforms, leaving them without a reliable means to monetize their courses. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions such as COREMERCH provide a structural alternative that bypasses these restrictions entirely. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, creators can establish their own independent online stores that function seamlessly, regardless of their geographical limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are critical considerations for creators. Stripe and PayPal often charge transaction fees and maintain lengthy processing times, especially for international payments. Furthermore, PayPal's potential for account suspensions introduces an element of risk that can jeopardize cash flow. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure typically operates with lower fees, such as the 0.5% fee charged by NOWPayments, and offers instant payment confirmations. This ensures that creators receive their funds quickly, without the fear of arbitrary freezes or holds.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership and control over your sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of using sovereign commerce infrastructure is the complete ownership that creators gain after deployment. With platforms like Stripe and PayPal, creators are often at the mercy of changing policies and potential account freezes. In contrast, COREMERCH solutions enable creators to maintain full control over their products, customer data, and payment processes. Additionally, with automated delivery mechanisms in place, creators can ensure a smooth transaction experience for their customers, significantly enhancing user satisfaction.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When selecting an architecture, consider both your geographical location and your business needs. If you're in a restricted country, the choice is clear: traditional platforms are not an option. The Edge Commerce Stack provides a robust solution that can be deployed quickly, giving you the infrastructure needed to sell courses effectively. With 30 days of support, you can get your online store up and running without the typical hassles associated with conventional payment processors. This is the route for creators who want to eliminate dependency on platforms that exclude them.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Eliminate dependency on platforms that exclude you based on geography.

The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by identifying your target market and determining what digital products you want to sell. Next, deploy the Edge Commerce Stack, which can be set up in just 48 hours. Load your products into the system and configure the payment processing with NOWPayments. Set up automated delivery mechanisms for your digital products. Finally, test your store to ensure everything functions smoothly before going live.
